title: Add CI gate running just validate-strict on PRs touching schema or data/traits/
impact: Prevents silent regression of every fix below; without it the corpus can revert to drift on the next merge

title: Promote validate-strict over validate-all as the default and document
impact: Stops users (and Claude) from trusting open-mode "all good" output that hides unknown-field drift

title: Validate trait records in scripts/seed_from_metpo.py before write
impact: Catches schema drift at seed time, not after commit; the seeder is the only writer of new trait YAMLs

title: Document the required: asymmetry on evidence (required on CausalEdge, optional on TraitRecord)
impact: Prevents a future cleanup PR from "harmonizing" away a deliberate editorial policy

title: Skip-self short-circuit in scripts/audit_writers.py to suppress the auditor false positive
impact: Cosmetic — keeps the writer audit report clean of self-referential noise
